I’m proud to co-sponsor H.R. 2493 the Improving Care in Rural America Reauthorization Act. I spoke at today’s @HouseCommerce Health Subcommittee hearing on why rural communities deserve quality care too. 🏥🩺 https://t.co/AnerMdP21B

There's a lot of fear mongering about people getting kicked off Medicaid. There's nothing in this bill that would impact Ohioans living with disabilities, kids living in poverty, or the elderly who rely on Medicaid. As a matter of fact, in Ohio, we’re going to get more federal dollars than ever for Medicaid recipients and rural hospitals.

Thank you @SecKennedy for ending these reckless experiments that have unleashed unfathomable havoc on the world. We need reform and I wholeheartedly support these efforts to get America’s health back on track.

Through the Working Families Tax Cuts, @HouseGOP created the $50B Rural Health Transformation Program which will give states the tools to strengthen hospitals, recruit and retain providers, improve outcomes for patients, and Make America Healthy Again! 💪🇺🇸

Families in Eastern Ohio and across rural America deserve quality, affordable care close to home. The Rural Health Transformation Program will strengthen small-town hospitals and support the doctors and nurses who serve us. I’ll work to ensure Ohio seizes this opportunity to deliver better health outcomes for rural families.
From the Youngstown to Marietta, rural Ohio deserves world class healthcare! The RHT Program invests $50B to transform access and outcomes @HouseGOP is delivering for our state.
Rural hospitals are lifelines in Ohio. A clean CR protects the Rural Health Fund and keeps care accessible in our communities. Democrats voted NO.

Democrats shut down your government to fund healthcare for people who broke our laws.

Republicans passed a clean bill to reopen the government and protect 6 million women and children who rely on WIC.
